items.title: Marshall Lawrence Interview, 1960-06-28
items.q: He was a good bass player.

ctx.x: No. When we played, we had a funeral marches. And I guess the Ornwood too, they had a pretty good band too. Ornwood band. I was a boy when they had a band.
Is Van Son Lashley dead or not?
Yeah, he's dead. He was a good bass player.
